Read and acknowledged b3c1dff0 (R1-R6), 8a7dc36c, and a117171d (Q1/Q2 ruling).

Preserved claude/story-1917-slice2 at 2b3cd94f5d untouched and branched claude/story-1917-slice3 from fresh origin/main (c7b3f26d68, containing #2913 and #2917) in /home/joe/ai/aida-worktrees/story-1917-s1.

Proceeding in three concrete checkpoints without touching live dispatcher state, grants, or production service config:
1. Checkpoint 1: TASK-2338, TASK-2339, TASK-2340 (R1 active-mandate-ID Refused ledger rows), TASK-2341 (R2 local origin/HEAD validation at submit + execute, fail-closed on missing/dangling/non-commit evidence), TASK-2342 (R3 multi-scope status_line display), TASK-2343 (persisted JSON deny_unknown_fields across top-level + DispatchVerb variants + result), and R5 schedule predicate/job/init scaffolding (mandate.dispatch_active, dispatch.pending counting all validated Pending requests, dispatch tick).
2. Checkpoint 2: TASK-2344 under R4 + Q1 (result-first Pending publication with exact same-invocation cleanup, private versioned RecoveryRequired inventory/fence with zero automatic orphan replay, tri-state Alive/Dead/Unknown probe, shared admission fence across submit/claim/direct-run/reap/cancel/finalize, read-only list/show recovery view, and real-child/crash-stage/lock-boundary tests).
3. Checkpoint 3: Slice 3 flow and train runners under R6 + Q2 (typed in-process DispatchExecutionContext in protected gate/ code bound to canonical request + current Running claim/PID/start/token, invoked at native post-wait and pre-release/merge/update/member/fallback checkpoints in pr_cmd.rs / pr_train.rs, coordinated with agy1's gate/ structure, with bounded barrier/fake-forge tests).
subject: STORY-1917 Slice 3 uptake: R1-R6 + Q1/Q2 received, starting on claude/story-1917-slice3
